selection: Exactly the seven unresolved two-generator cover presentations in three_sheet_nonabelian_results.json, not new knots or covers
motivation: For a simple3-branched cover, a nonabelian permutation image proves rank>=2 and therefore mr>=4. Rather than enlarge a finite-field sweep, apply bounded exact Todd-Coxeter enumeration to the actual retained presentation. Any returned action is only accepted after direct original-word evaluation and noncommutation, independently of the enumeration algorithm.
implementation: Pinned local Sympy1.14.0 HLT enumeration of the trivial subgroup; compress and standardize the table, export inverse generator permutations to convert the right coset action to a left representation
acceptance: Only independently replayed noncommuting generator permutations with all original branched-cover relators satisfied establish a sharp case. Cyclic returned images do not certify that the source group is cyclic; cap/time failure gives no rank conclusion. Named-knot/source and upper-bound reviews remain required for a new closure claim.
scope: A bounded exact certificate proposal, not a complete finite-quotient/nonabelianity decision or a full MRC proof.
